notes: Master total 194 as printed in the PokeCottage PDF header ('194 cards (plus promos and variants)'). Grand master total 222 is derived, not printed: master 194 + 14 promos + 14 variants listed in the PDF's Grand Master Set section. Card names/rarities cross-checked against TCGdex (api.pokemontcg.io returned 502/500 on 2026-11-26, so TCGdex was the cross-check source). Card images use the Pokemon TCG API's own image host (images.scrydex.com, pattern /pokemon/<setid>-<number>/small). Promo/variant images are null (no verified URL). Promo rarity is recorded as 'Promo' (PokeCottage lists no rarity for promos). Variant entries use the printed number form 'NNN/PPP' and carry the base card's rarity. Reverse Holo entries use TCGdex's per-card reverse flag (74 cards); it agrees exactly with the Common/Uncommon/Rare rule (37 + 26 + 11). v1.0.2 (Nov 26, 2026): Master Set redefined per Jeremy — one of each card number (incl. secret rares); holo / reverse-holo / stamp variations are Grand Master only. Master 194 -> 120; Grand unchanged at 222.
